note: review: The single 'K.x=truen[K]' scenario still holds if finalize_pending set the flags recursively or never cleared the set; neither recursive=False (observable as '[a.b.d]' after 'a.b.c=1' and another header) nor the clear() at :241 (observable after an array-of-tables reset) is pinned.

note: review: Scenarios 2 and 6 only contain flags under K, so an unset_all that cleared the whole flag tree satisfies TableRules; that it drops only the subtree under key (':245-249', observable as '[a]n[[b]]n[a]') is never stated.

name: NestedDict.append_nest_to_list
note: review: Create, append and the 'An object other than list' KeyError are pinned, but no scenario nests an array of tables inside another ('[[a]]n[[a.b]]'), so the walk into the last element that get_or_create_nest(key[:-1]) does with access_lists=True (:303) is unpinned; passing access_lists=False also satisfies TableRules.
